aov_inv_box_of_holding_visible_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_visible = yes }
}
aov_inv_box_of_holding_unlocked_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_unlocked = yes }
}
aov_inv_box_of_holding_undiscovered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_unlocked = yes NOT = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_discovered = yes } }
}
aov_inv_box_of_holding_activate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_discovered = yes NOT = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_active = yes } }
	is_valid = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_available = yes aov_artificery_has_free_slot = yes }
	effect = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_activate = yes }
}
aov_inv_box_of_holding_deactivate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_active = yes }
	effect = {
		aov_invention_box_of_holding_deactivate = yes
		aov_artificery_start_slot_cooldown = yes
	}
}
# Clicking the invention box: activate, or deactivate if active
aov_inv_box_of_holding_toggle_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		aov_invention_box_of_holding_discovered = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_active = yes } }
			aov_invention_box_of_holding_available = yes
			aov_artificery_has_free_slot = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_active = yes }
			aov_invention_box_of_holding_deactivate = yes
			aov_artificery_start_slot_cooldown = yes
		}
		else = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_activate = yes }
	}
}
aov_inv_box_of_holding_offered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_offered = yes aov_invention_box_of_holding_discoverable = yes }
}
aov_inv_box_of_holding_research_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { aov_artificery_can_sponsor = { FACTION = technomancers } aov_invention_box_of_holding_discoverable = yes }
	effect = { aov_artificery_start_technomancers_research = { CATEGORY = economic TARGET = box_of_holding } }
}
# Never executed: its tooltip shows the invention's effects
aov_inv_box_of_holding_effects_sgui = {
	scope = character
	effect = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_box_of_holding } }
}

	is_shown = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_unlocked = yes NOT = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_discovered = yes } }
}
aov_inv_damestear_powder_activate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_discovered = yes NOT = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_active = yes } }
	is_valid = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_available = yes aov_artificery_has_free_slot = yes }
	effect = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_activate = yes }
}
aov_inv_damestear_powder_deactivate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_active = yes }
	effect = {
		aov_invention_damestear_powder_deactivate = yes
		aov_artificery_start_slot_cooldown = yes
	}
}
# Clicking the invention box: activate, or deactivate if active
aov_inv_damestear_powder_toggle_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		aov_invention_damestear_powder_discovered = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_active = yes } }
			aov_invention_damestear_powder_available = yes
			aov_artificery_has_free_slot = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_active = yes }
			aov_invention_damestear_powder_deactivate = yes
			aov_artificery_start_slot_cooldown = yes
		}
		else = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_activate = yes }
	}
}
aov_inv_damestear_powder_offered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_offered = yes aov_invention_damestear_powder_discoverable = yes }
}
aov_inv_damestear_powder_research_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { aov_artificery_can_sponsor = { FACTION = technomancers } aov_invention_damestear_powder_discoverable = yes }
	effect = { aov_artificery_start_technomancers_research = { CATEGORY = military TARGET = damestear_powder } }
}
# Never executed: its tooltip shows the invention's effects
aov_inv_damestear_powder_effects_sgui = {
	scope = character
	effect = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_damestear_powder } }
}

	is_shown = { aov_invention_fey_spray_visible = yes }
}
aov_inv_fey_spray_unlocked_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_fey_spray_unlocked = yes }
}
aov_inv_fey_spray_undiscovered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_fey_spray_unlocked = yes NOT = { aov_invention_fey_spray_discovered = yes } }
}
aov_inv_fey_spray_activate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_fey_spray_discovered = yes NOT = { aov_invention_fey_spray_active = yes } }
	is_valid = { aov_invention_fey_spray_available = yes aov_artificery_has_free_slot = yes }
	effect = { aov_invention_fey_spray_activate = yes }
}
aov_inv_fey_spray_deactivate_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_fey_spray_active = yes }
	effect = {
		aov_invention_fey_spray_deactivate = yes
		aov_artificery_start_slot_cooldown = yes
	}
}
# Clicking the invention box: activate, or deactivate if active
aov_inv_fey_spray_toggle_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		aov_invention_fey_spray_discovered = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { aov_invention_fey_spray_active = yes } }
			aov_invention_fey_spray_available = yes
			aov_artificery_has_free_slot = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { aov_invention_fey_spray_active = yes }
			aov_invention_fey_spray_deactivate = yes
			aov_artificery_start_slot_cooldown = yes
		}
		else = { aov_invention_fey_spray_activate = yes }
	}
}
aov_inv_fey_spray_offered_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { aov_invention_fey_spray_offered = yes aov_invention_fey_spray_discoverable = yes }
}
aov_inv_fey_spray_research_sgui = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { aov_artificery_can_sponsor = { FACTION = technomancers } aov_invention_fey_spray_discoverable = yes }
	effect = { aov_artificery_start_technomancers_research = { CATEGORY = society TARGET = fey_spray } }
}
# Never executed: its tooltip shows the invention's effects
aov_inv_fey_spray_effects_sgui = {
	scope = character
	effect = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_fey_spray } }
}
